name: Unique wood designs
old_description: Introducing Unique Wood Designs, where creativity meets craftsmanship! We specialize in custom cabinetry, stunning wood remodels, and one-of-a-kind wood designs tailored just for you. Let us bring your vision to life!
about:
Unique Wood Designs operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where it provides custom woodworking services for residential and commercial clients. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in available materials.

The shop specializes in custom cabinetry, wood remodels, and one-of-a-kind wood designs tailored to individual projects. Its artisans handcraft pieces using traditional woodworking techniques combined with modern design concepts, producing items such as kitchen cabinets, built-in bookshelves, accent walls, decking, flooring, bathroom vanities, staircases, and commercial bar fixtures. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Unique Wood Designs serves both residential and commercial customers. Homeowners commission custom kitchens, built-in bookshelves, accent walls, playrooms, bunk beds, and bathroom vanities. Business clients have ordered outdoor decks, patios, bar fixtures, and commercial cabinetry. The company emphasizes personalized consultations to match each client's style and functional needs.

The company states that its differentiation lies in personalized consultations, careful material selection, and a blend of traditional craftsmanship with innovative design. It aims to deliver unique, durable pieces through attention to detail from concept to completion.
